title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Excel Reports that Become Generally Available

chapters.title: Introduction to Excel Reports in Business Central
Excel Layouts Moving to General Availability
Demo: Running and Opening Trial Balance Report

features.name: Excel Layouts for Built-in Reports
features.description: New Excel layouts that replace AL-coded built-in reports, allowing users to generate reports in Excel format with Power Query for data connections.
caveats: Uses Power Query which needs to be opened for external communication

features.name: Report Customization in Excel
features.description: Users can completely change the look and feel of Excel reports by removing rows, hiding tabs, adjusting spacing, and modifying pivot table fields after downloading.
caveats: Users need to clear filters before uploading modified reports back
Slicer positioning may change in generally available version

features.name: Slicer Controls for Report Filtering
features.description: Excel reports include slicers that allow users to filter data by dimensions like fixed assets categories, with plans to position them on the right side in the GA version.
features.status_evidence_quote: generally available version we'll likely put these slices to the right
caveats: Slicer placement may be subject to change in final GA release

features.name: Finance Analytics Documentation
features.description: Comprehensive documentation landing page for finance reports including descriptions, worksheets with screenshots, use cases by persona, and links to try reports directly.

features.name: Excel Reports with Copilot Integration
features.description: Documentation includes tips on how to use raw data from pivot tables with Copilot for enhanced analysis capabilities.

features.name: Alternative Analysis Methods Documentation
features.description: Documentation provides links to alternative ways to analyze financial data including Power BI, legacy reports, and the financial reporting feature.
